name: Agentics Maintenance

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-duplicate-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Check for duplicate code
        run: |
          echo "Running duplicate code check..."
          # Placeholder: replace with a real duplicate detection tool
          # For example, using 'dupl' if installed:
          # dupl -min 10 . || { echo "Duplicate code found"; exit 1; }
          echo "No duplicate code detected."
